diagnoses.label: Q02 representative TC selection contradicts coldest/worst-case guidance
diagnoses.observable_evidence: In reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit/SKILL.md under “Deterministic sensor selection (tie-breaks)”, it states: “If selecting minimum metric (e.g., ‘coldest’ TAL or peak): choose (min_value, smallest_tc_id).” This implies Q02 TAL should use the minimum TAL across thermocouples (worst-case/coldest). However, the task asks: “If multiple values exist, select the most representative thermocouple value based on the handbook details,” and the location hint flags “Q02 的代表热电偶选择部分,” indicating the current guidance is likely wrong/misaligned for TAL selection (representative vs worst-case).
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Thermocouple reduction logic specifically for Q02 TAL per-run tc_id selection when multiple thermocouples exist
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Q01 ramp selection (max metric) and Q03 peak selection (min peak/cold spot) where worst-case logic is commonly required
diagnoses.target_section: Deterministic sensor selection (tie-breaks) / Q02 TAL representative thermocouple selection guidance
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Split sensor-selection guidance by metric/question: explicitly define Q02 TAL tc selection rule as handbook-driven (representative vs worst-case) and keep deterministic tie-breaks within that rule; avoid globally asserting TAL is always a min-metric without handbook confirmation.

diagnoses.label: Deliverables/completion criteria not explicitly bound to required output files per question
diagnoses.observable_evidence: The task requires generating five specific files (/app/output/q01.json ... q05.json) with strict formatting (rounding, sorting, null handling). In reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit/SKILL.md, “Output construction guardrails” and scaffold mention writing outputs into /app/output, but there is no explicit deliverable checklist mapping each question to its required filename and schema, and the location hint flags “交付物和任务完成条件.”
diagnoses.scope_boundary: End-to-end delivery requirements for producing q01–q05 JSON artifacts with required schemas and filenames
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Internal computation recipes (sorting, interpolation, slope) which are already specified and should remain unchanged
diagnoses.target_section: Output construction guardrails / add explicit Deliverables & Done Criteria section
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add a concise deliverables section enumerating q01.json–q05.json, required schema constraints (2dp rounding, sorted keys/arrays, null instead of NaN), and a ‘done’ checklist to prevent partial delivery.

overlay.composition_issue: Current global tie-break guidance implicitly forces TAL to be treated as a min-metric (worst-case) while the task/handbook-driven requirement may demand a ‘representative thermocouple’ rule for Q02; without per-question binding, deterministic selection can be consistently wrong even if computations are correct.
preservation_constraints: Preserve existing deterministic computation recipes (sorting by time, dt<=0 handling, slope equation, interpolation for time-above-threshold).
Preserve Q01 ramp selection as max-metric with stable tie-breaks and Q03 peak logic as min-peak (cold spot) unless handbook indicates otherwise.
Preserve rounding/null/NaN guardrails and lexicographic sorting requirements.

package_assessment.rationale: Defects are localized to SKILL.md guidance (deliverable binding and Q02 sensor-selection policy). Adjusting documentation/mechanism text can resolve the mis-specification without needing external data or changing unrelated computation mechanisms.
